text.index.p.a-relaxed-little-studio-where-yo: A professional studio that doesn't cost $1000 a day.
text.index.h2.first-time-in-a-studio-here: First Time in a Studio? Here's how it works:
text.index.p.nobody-s-born-knowing-how-this: Recording in a studio is pretty daunting at first. Don't worry, it's a lot simpler than it looks!
text.index.p.no-rush-and-no-judgment-we: No rush and no judgment. We'll mess with sounds, experiment, and keep going until we have a sound you love.
text.index.p.we-mix-it-so-everything-sits: We apply the finishing touches to make sure everything sounds perfect, and then work on getting it published!
text.index.p.it-s-meant-to-feel-like: The Alcove is hands-down one of the most comfortable spaces in Provo. Take a Look!
text.index.p.there-s-real-gear-around-to: The room where it happens. This room can comfortably fit up to 5 musicians, and is where most work gets done. If you're a solo songwriter, or a 4-piece band, this is where the recording happens. When you book a session, you get full access to the great collection of instruments and gear that you need to make a great record. From an original golden-era custom OCDP drum kit, to a genuine Korg MS-20 synthesizer, you don't have to worry about the quality of your instrument- we have everything you'll need. Along with the great collection of instruments, there is also a great collection of gadgets, gizmos, and doohickeys to keep you inspired throughout the whole process. No matter where you look, theres always something to catch your eye and give you an idea for your next lyric. Creativity is something that's hard to control, so having a comfortable space is extremely important for recording.
text.index.p.it-feels-more-like-a-friend: This room is mainly used for live bands, choirs, string sections, and horn sections that call for a larger space to record effectively. It comes with great-sounding acoustics, a large floor space, and a Kawai grand piano to ensure that no project is too large to record.
text.index.p.i-m-here-to-help-you: Built in the 60's, the home of the Alcove is filled with character and wonder that is hard to find anywhere else.
text.index.p.all-kinds-of-music-all-kinds: Any type of business is welcome. We've recorded everything from pop musicians, to jazz quartets, and even podcast episodes.
text.index.p.you-don-t-need-any-experience: Don't feel rushed! When you're ready, go ahead and fill out the form and I'll get back to you ASAP.
